title: Core Quintet #04
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 5:4 aspect ratio, five women in a single row.

A photograph of FIVE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 5 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Emirati woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, bold and confident, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman. Colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame. Not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye — a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs, wide white bands following every deep crease, dense spiral resist motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme white ballet heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Pakistani woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, demure and soft, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, chrome finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern — a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands, wide magenta-and-gold bands following every deep crease, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.

Left woman's footwear: extreme magenta-and-gold platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult Brazilian woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, sun-bronzed glowing skin, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, cool and composed, soft pastel-pink hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glittery finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework — a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease, dense geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Center woman's pose: back fully to camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme gold-and-red extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Thai woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, a poised, dramatic expression, cool and composed, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Klimt-inspired organic mosaic — an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense organic curved mosaic filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.

Right woman's footwear: extreme gold plain stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, porcelain-pale skin, slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, a serene expression, sultry, warm honey-blonde hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in Turkish İznik tile — a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems, wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme cobalt-and-coral plain stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 5, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 5:4 landscape 8K.
